text: Stacking implementer branches on an unmerged PR branch breaks under squash-merge: merging main into the stacked branch gives add/add conflicts on every file the base PR added. Fix used: cherry-pick only the issue's own commit onto origin/main under a new branch name (force-push is denied). Prevention: dispatch stacked work only after the base merges, or have the implementer base on a throwaway integration branch and cherry-pick at PR time.

An isolation:worktree subagent that stops with no changes has its worktree auto-removed; a SendMessage resume then runs it in the main checkout. Don't brief implementers to 'stop and report' on a first-step merge failure: either make the first step unable to fail (plain merge, not --ff-only), or re-dispatch fresh rather than resume.

Every parallel M1 PR adds keys to the single assets/deepcharter/lang/en_us.json, so each merge after the first conflicts and needs a hand union plus a re-gate review. Prevention: per-feature lang fragments (lang/parts/<feature>.json) merged into en_us.json by a Gradle processResources step, so no two features touch the same file.

Agent worktree sandbox refused shell commands containing 'git' inside a path (src/main/java/io/github/...), so the implementer had to split and rephrase commands. A sandbox rule that matches 'git' as a command word, not a path substring, would prevent it.

tools/record-evidence.sh rejected its own 9.7 MB GIF at the 5 MB cap (63-frame fly-through, #54), so the implementer rebuilt it by hand with ffmpeg (640 px, 64 colours, no dither). The script should step down size, palette or frame rate itself until the GIF fits.
